insights: **Weekly Highlights —** Heavenly Bodies generated $8,446 in total sales in Week 46 on 150 units, with the Tarot Deluxe Boxset leading at $6,895 and improving its conversion to 6.3% (+14.9%). The Tarot 3-pack grew to $351 (+200.0%) and the Tarot & Astrology 2-pack held steady at $574 (+0.5%). Monday, Nov 9 was the peak day at $1,579.

**Metrics to Watch —** Total sales eased 15.9% from $10,042 the prior week, mainly because Tarot Boxset sessions fell 28.3% to 1986. The Astrology Boxset dipped to $625 (-38.8%) with conversion at 3.0%. Our focus is rebuilding traffic to both decks so the stronger Tarot conversion turns into more sales.

**Ad Spend Efficiency —** Ad spend of $749 generated $1,916 in PPC revenue for a 2.55x ROAS (prior 3.71x) and 39.1% ACOS, with TACoS a lean 8.9%. Ad CTR is 0.37% and ad conversion is 2.83% of clicks, so tightening targeting toward high-intent tarot and astrology gift searches is the clearest path back toward last week's ROAS.

**Actions This Week —** We will shift budget toward the best-converting Tarot Boxset keywords, add negatives on clicks that are not converting, and test new Sponsored Brand ad creative to lift the 0.37% ad CTR. We will also build gift-focused campaigns for the bundle packs, following the Tarot 3-pack's +200.0% week, as we head into the holiday season.
